description: Books an appointment. Real and immediate: the salon holds the time and the customer gets a confirmation text. It can't be cancelled or changed online, only by calling the salon. Repeating the same call returns the same booking, never a second one.

agent_name.description: Name of the AI assistant making the booking, e.g. "Claude". The salon sees "Booked by <agent_name>".

customer_name.description: The customer's name, as the salon should greet them.

customer_phone.description: The customer's mobile number; the confirmation text goes here.

service_id.description: The service's id on the salon's menu.

start_at.description: ISO start time of an open slot for this salon and service.

name: book_appointment
title: Book an appointment
